source: WOOD Magazine, How to Make Box Joints
conversion: 1 in = 25.4 mm; the source says workpiece width should be an increment of finger width, giving 21 quarter-inch positions across 5 1/4 in.
tolerance: Exact finger count; actual finger width and edge waste to 0.01 mm engine precision.
scope: Validates only the published integral-width example's finger count, finger width, and absence of partial edge fingers. Glue-area output and the calculator's general odd-count adjustment are excluded.
